claim: In the matching retail DLL, SkillDataMan.IsS1Waza (0x06005266) is a static one-SkillData-parameter method named w returning Boolean with an exact 40-byte body. It reads w.skillType (field token 0x04007C51) three times through one ordered branch graph: the initial brfalse sends raw value 0 directly to the true return; raw value 1 reaches the same true return through beq; raw value 9 reaches true by falling through the final bne.un test; every other raw value branches to false. Therefore the exact raw true set in this method is {0,1,9}. FACT-0021 pins this helper at CalcDamage IL+0x03AD in its S1-rule path, and FACT-0022 pins it at CriticalCheck IL+0x0272 in its own S1-rule path.
